narr: This is a continuation of the July 17-21 Thunderstorms episode, which lasted ten days total.
ev: Short Creek flooded and closed several bridges and low water crossings in Colorado City. One vehicle was rescued.
A pickup truck tried to cross a flooded intersection on Queens Bay Road and got swept downstream.
Hackberry Road was closed from Highway 93 to East Austin Peak Road, and Knight Creek Road was closed from Hackberry Road to milepost 4.6 due to flooding.
Antares Road was closed from Highway 66 to Pierce Ferry Road due to flooding.
There were at least four swift water rescues, and numerous roads were closed.
Waist deep water flowed over the intersection of Bank Street and Calle Castano.
Hackberry Road was closed from Main Street to Route 66 due to flooding.
Oatman Highway was closed due to flooding.
The intersection of Oatman Highway and Route 66 was flooded.
Signal Road was closed from Highway 93 to Alamo Road due to flooding.
